store.description: Need for Speed: Most Wanted, running in the browser through a WebAssembly port. Tear through Rockport, outrun the police and climb the Blacklist — no install, just drive.
features: Rockport open city with police chases
Keyboard controls: WASD / arrows to drive, Space to brake
Embedded fan port — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
